about: Shared cases for the demo key's expected-word match (journeys/demo-key-score.mjs and backend/scripts/financial_agent_fit_replay.py expect_hit). An expected word counts as a whole word; an expected number never counts as a calendar day or part of a written date. Measured 11 Nov 2026 on the 6 recorded Q1 answers: word presence credited 'apartment' from 'Larkmont Apartments' in a caveat and '14' from the 14 June seizure date.
